callouts.text: **R304 is a build-time break, not a flake.** [#32890](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32890) merged Jul-30; the hardcoded 32-bit mask `0xFFFFFFFF` in `inclusive_sum` (`warp.cuh:184`) fails `static_assert(sizeof(MaskT)==8)` on ROCm/gfx942 & gfx950/ROCm 7.2. details.label: Status
details.text: NEW today, **largest cluster (~17 jobs across all 5 AMD workflows)**. Last green Jul-31; first fail Aug-01. Build-time break, deterministic.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#32890](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32890) ([`fb207b72`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/fb207b72), verified "feat(kernels): port standalone Kimi K3 kernels", merged Jul-30) added `inclusive_sum` calling `__shfl_up_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, …)` — a 32-bit mask — at `warp.cuh:184` with no `USE_ROCM`/wave64 guard; ROCm's header requires a 64-bit mask (`static_assert sizeof(MaskT)==8`). **Disconfirming**: (none — clean temporal + code correlation; reproduced with default aiter in scout baselines). **How to verify**: apply [#33195](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33195), re-run `jit-kernel-unit-test-amd`.

*(Also R304 in scout jobs [91413778127](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30716848145/job/91413778127), [91413790182](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30716848145/job/91413790182); jit-kernel-benchmark-rocm720 [91398591706](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30711087351/job/91398591706) — same root cause, omitted for brevity.)*
